reading: Products and catalogue structure: WooCommerce's Products menu, All Products, Add New and Products settings tab (WC-S-0049, WC-S-0050, WC-S-0051, WC-S-0002) and its products REST API (WC-S-0670). M-011 holds Shopify's one products concern and Salla's four; WooCommerce keeps attributes, variations, categories, tags and brands in this one concern, so it lands in the parent, as SH-C-020 does. Its sub-parts are cited in CM-CAT-002 (attributes and variations), CM-CAT-003 (categories), CM-CAT-005 (brands) and CM-CAT-006 (tags); its product custom fields (WC-S-0096, WC-S-0675) are left to domain E, as the anchor left Salla's (U-005).

Joined on role, a reading. WooCommerce's Downloadable products, with the setting that grants a customer access to downloadable files after payment and the file download method (WC-S-0014, WC-S-5395, WC-S-5393), play the part of Salla's digital products delivered as digital files (the digital-file feature, SA-S-3498; the plan line إرسال محتوى المنتجات الرقمية, sending digital products' content, SA-S-1999) and of Shopify's Digital goods and service apps (SH-S-2648). No statement of WC-C-066 says digital (the one WooCommerce statement on digital goods, WC-C-118/reason/WC-S-5465, is about VAT on them and names no downloadable product), and Q1 left the terms apart (U-061), so the join rests on the role: a product whose content the buyer receives as a file.

Inventory and stock levels: the Products > Inventory settings section, the stock management switch woocommerce_manage_stock and Analytics > Stock (WC-S-0013, WC-S-5400, WC-S-0074). M-012 is one to one. Its hold-stock setting is cited in the child CM-INV-008, its products-low-in-stock API in the child CM-INV-004.

Cost of goods sold: the 'Cost of goods' field of the product (_cogs_value, WC-S-5446) and the cost_of_goods_sold feature that 'Allows entering cost of goods sold information for products' (WC-S-5445). No capability of the model held a product's cost (the anchor made none, U-070), so it is a new child of CM-CAT-001, the product record. After the dry run's review, the back-fill's Shopify cell cites Shopify's staff permissions for a product's cost (C2).

Subscriptions: WooCommerce Subscriptions, 'a premium extension that allows you to sell products and services with recurring payments' (WC-S-5351), and the Marketplace category Subscriptions (WC-S-0739). M-074 is one to one: subscriptions a store sells to its customers.

Bookings and appointments: the Marketplace category (WC-S-0731) and WooCommerce Bookings' availability rules and REST API (WC-S-5352, WC-S-5470). M-081 joins it with Salla's bookings (SA-C-031), which the anchor landed here.

Memberships: the Marketplace category Memberships (WC-S-0728), the concern's only statement. No capability of the model holds memberships, and no statement makes them recurring payments, so they are not landed in CM-SEL-001.

Joined by the term bundle: the Marketplace category Bundles (WC-S-0732) and Product Bundles' bundled_by and bundled_items properties (WC-S-5474), with Shopify's Upsell and bundle apps (SH-S-2604) and Salla's advance-bundle-product (SA-S-3510). Strained: the concern is WooCommerce's Merchandising group of Marketplace categories. Outside CM-SEL-006's tree, Product options and Product variations (WC-S-0737, WC-S-0738) are CM-CAT-002's and Pricing (WC-S-0735) is CM-CAT-013's (added after the dry run's review, S8), and both are cited there; Gifts, Order options and Product display (WC-S-0733, WC-S-0734, WC-S-0736) are of other domains (gifting D, order options C, display E); Additional purchases (WC-S-0729) names nothing a statement defines. Bundles is the one category with a statement beyond its name (my judgment; notes).
